mapping.summary: Handles EU Deforestation Regulation due diligence and TRACES filings inside Business Central.
claims: Direct link to the EU TRACES API, versions 2 and 3, with test and live modes
Due diligence statements can be created, submitted, amended and withdrawn, with status fetched automatically
Reference and verification numbers are assigned on posting a sale and printed on shipment and invoice
Checks supplier reference numbers against TRACES on purchase, sales and item tracking lines
Configurable check level per purchase order and invoice, up to verified plus approved risk assessment
Article 10 risk assessment by vendor, item, country of origin or document with yearly renewal
Includes EU country benchmarking with simplified due diligence for low-risk countries
Imports sanctions from the EU Sanctions Map plus corruption and conflict country data
Shows Global Forest Watch deforestation alerts per plot
Azure Maps editor for drawing plot points and polygons with automatic hectare calculation
EUDR obligation can be set per item, item category or tariff number
Carries references through assembly, lot and serial numbers and transfers
Sends multi-level email reminders to suppliers missing reference numbers
Supplier role center for suppliers working directly in your Business Central
Supports operators, traders and downstream operators
Optional supplier web portal add-on for reference numbers, plots and questionnaires
Runs on BC online, with on-premises available on request
